description: Apply the review fixes that need no decision: renames with exactly the same meaning (BoxBufferGeometry -> BoxGeometry, THREE.Math -> MathUtils, applyMatrix -> applyMatrix4, three/examples/jsm -> three/addons, outputEncoding/encoding -> colorSpace, merged geometry utils) and a capped pixel ratio. Shows what it would change unless write is true; a write is one undoable step (three_undo). Run three_review afterwards; the rest needs a decision.

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

rewrites.description: also apply the rewrites that change more than a name (render argument order, color.set(), the missing .js, TransformControls.getHelper()); the dry run lists them

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

name: three_fix
title: Apply mechanical three.js fixes
